headline: OpenAI reportedly disbanded its preparedness team
summary: OpenAI reportedly dissolved its preparedness team last month. This team was responsible for assessing and mitigating serious AI risks. The disbandment raises concerns about future AI model safety.

headline: Open Mike Eagle and Kenny Segal crafted a hip hop breakup masterpiece
summary: Open Mike Eagle and Kenny Segal released their new album, 'DOOMED!'. The record explores the emotional complexities of breakups with artistic depth. Eagle's signature personal style shines through in this acclaimed hip-hop work.

headline: Amazon is trying to crush class-action suits before they get started
summary: Amazon updated its terms, requiring disputes to be resolved through arbitration. New terms also include a class action waiver for users. Critics say this change is designed to limit consumer lawsuits, not streamline resolutions.

headline: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
summary: ChatGPT's new macOS feature, Computer History, logs user activity. It collects clicks and keystrokes to learn user workflows and suggest automations. This data is used to train ChatGPT and Codex, raising privacy concerns.

headline: 'Look Forward to Meetin' Ya, Sugah!' — Rogue Voice Actress Lenore Zann Reacts to MCU X-Men Casting With Special Video Message for Inde Navarrette
summary: Lenore Zann, the original voice of Rogue, congratulated Inde Navarrette. Navarrette was cast as the live-action Rogue in the MCU X-Men reboot. Zann shared a special video message, embracing the new casting.

headline: Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Sparks Theories About 2 Doctor Dooms as Fans Hope for a Surprise Cameo from Cillian Murphy
summary: The new Avengers: Doomsday trailer hints at the possibility of two Doctor Dooms. Fans are speculating about potential plot twists and character introductions. There's also buzz about a surprise cameo from actor Cillian Murphy.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth for Switch 2, Nioh 3, Project Hail Mary, and More
summary: Discover today's top gaming and entertainment deals. Find discounts on anticipated titles like Final Fantasy VII Rebirth for Switch 2. Explore offers for Nioh 3, Project Hail Mary, and other popular items.

headline: Simu Liu Says Sleeping Dogs Movie Has 'a REAL Path Forward' Amid Dealmaking With Square Enix
summary: Simu Liu provides an optimistic update on the Sleeping Dogs movie adaptation. He confirms the film now has 'a REAL path forward'. Negotiations with game publisher Square Enix are ongoing for the project.

headline: Trump envoy Kushner meets Hamas leader to push Gaza peace plan
summary: Jared Kushner met with a Hamas leader to advance a Gaza peace plan. This rare meeting follows Israel's rejection of Trump's initial plan. The envoy aims to push forward the proposed peace initiative.

headline: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026
summary: Russia reports seven deaths in Ukraine's largest attack of 2026. Moscow also launched deadly strikes across Kyiv overnight. The attacks sparked fires and intensified the ongoing conflict.

headline: Five teenagers dead and four injured after car drives on wrong side of motorway
summary: Five teenagers died and four were injured in a tragic motorway collision. The accident occurred when a car drove on the wrong side of the M9 Northbound. Authorities are investigating the incident in County Kildare.

headline: Trump says US to scale back military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
summary: Trump announced the US will reduce military drills with South Korea. The decision follows South Korea's non-involvement in the Iran war. Trump cited his 'very good relationship' with North Korea's leader.
